The Barber

It’s personal. That’s the point.

When you book Fresh Fades by T, you get Tee — start to finish. No rotating chairs, no handoffs. Every cut starts with a quick consult so the fade, the shape, and the finish match what you want, then it gets dialed in until it’s right.

Because it’s one chair by appointment, your time is held just for you. Show up, get a clean cut without the wait, and walk out fresh.

  • One barber, every timeYou build a real relationship with your barber — and a cut that stays consistent.
  • Your time is reservedAppointment-only means no waiting room and no rush in the chair.
  • Detail-obsessedCrisp lineups, blended skin fades, and beard work finished by hand.

Good to know

Questions, answered

Do you take walk-ins?
No — Fresh Fades by T is appointments only. Booking ahead guarantees your time and your chair, with no waiting room. Tap “Book with Tee” or call (720) 297-8561.
How do I book an appointment?
Use the booking form above, tap “Book with Tee,” or message the chat assistant in the corner — it takes a few details and sends your request. You can also call or text (720) 297-8561.
Do you do beard work and shaves?
Absolutely — beard shaping, lineups, and classic hot-towel straight-razor shaves. Pair a cut and beard in the Cut + Beard Combo for the full reset.
Where are you located?
15005 E Mississippi Ave, Aurora, CO 80012. Tap “Get directions” for the map. Hours are Mon–Fri 9AM–7PM and Saturday 9AM–5PM, by appointment.
